chapters.title: How to Find the Lord

paragraphs.text: Náhaḿ tiśt́hámi Vaekuńt́he na ca yogináḿ hrdaye, Ahaḿ tiśt́hámi Nárada mad bhakta yatra gáyante.
summary: Náhaḿ tiśt́hámi Vaekuńt́he na ca yogináḿ hrdaye, Ahaḿ tiśt́hámi Nárada mad bhakta yatra gáyante.

paragraphs.text: “Oh, Nárada, I don't stay in Vaekuńt́ha, nor in the hearts of Yogiis; but I reside where my devotees sing.”
summary: “Oh, Nárada, I don't stay in Vaekuńt́ha, nor in the hearts of Yogiis; but I reside where my devotees sing.

paragraphs.text: Vaekuńt́ha is the mythological abode of the Lord. But the Lord says that, that is not an ideal abode for Him. Nor does He like to reside in Yogiis' hearts, because the Yogiis have their hearts closed. Now if their hearts are closed, where will the Lord reside? So He shifts His abode, His nucleus, to that place where His devotees are singing the Lord's name, they are doing their Kiirtana.
summary: Vaekuńt́ha is the mythological abode of the Lord.
Nor does He like to reside in Yogiis' hearts, because the Yogiis have their hearts closed.
So He shifts His abode, His nucleus, to that place where His devotees are singing the Lord's name, they are doing their Kiirtana.

paragraphs.text: So the Cosmic Entity, the Supreme Father, has no other alternative but to shift His nucleus to the spot where His devotees are singing. So you are to create an environment of Divinity, not only on this small planet, but in the entire Cosmos. So you must. If you want to gain, if you want to taste, the Divine bliss, the Divine nectar, you should be good Kiirtanites.
summary: So the Cosmic Entity, the Supreme Father, has no other alternative but to shift His nucleus to the spot where His devotees are singing.
So you are to create an environment of Divinity, not only on this small planet, but in the entire Cosmos.
If you want to gain, if you want to taste, the Divine bliss, the Divine nectar, you should be good Kiirtanites.

paragraphs.text: And if you want this artificially-divided humanity to become one – spiritually it is one but in physical and psychic realms different ideals have divided this singular entity into many – if you want to make them one in the realm of physicality and intellectuality you must bind them, you must bring them to a platform that knows no artificial boundaries.
summary: And if you want this artificially-divided humanity to become one – spiritually it is one but in physical and psychic realms different ideals have divided this singular entity into many – if you want to make them one in the realm of physicality and intellectuality you must bind them, you must bring them to a platform that knows no artificial boundaries.

chapters.title: The Birthright of All

paragraphs.text: Last night's discourse was regarding the value of kiirtana in spiritual life. The entire spiritual world is based on divine love. You are the creation. You are the created. And the Supreme Entity is your creator. Your relationship with Him is the relationship of love, not of hatred, or any other such thing.
summary: Last night's discourse was regarding the value of kiirtana in spiritual life.
You are the creation.
Your relationship with Him is the relationship of love, not of hatred, or any other such thing.

paragraphs.text: You see, even if you are a sinner, a so-called sinner – I said so-called sinner, because I never hate anybody, I never scold anybody, saying that you are a sinner. A father can never hate his son or daughter. He may scold, he may punish, but he cannot hate.
summary: You see, even if you are a sinner, a so-called sinner – I said so-called sinner, because I never hate anybody, I never scold anybody, saying that you are a sinner.
A father can never hate his son or daughter.
He may scold, he may punish, but he cannot hate.

paragraphs.text: Parama Puruśa cannot do two things, and there lies His imperfection. He cannot create a second Parama Puruśa. He always remains a singular Entity. He loves, but while loving He wants that entity to also become Parama Puruśa, like Him. But as soon as that entity becomes Parama Puruśa, that entity becomes one with the original Parama Puruśa So Parama Puruśa always remains One. He cannot create a second Parama Puruśa. And the second thing he cannot do is: He cannot hate anybody. The society may hate a sinner. The law may hate a sinner. The family may hate a sinner. But Parama Puruśa cannot hate anybody. Even if He wants to hate such a man, or such a girl, He cannot.
summary: Parama Puruśa cannot do two things, and there lies His imperfection.
And the second thing he cannot do is: He cannot hate anybody.
Even if He wants to hate such a man, or such a girl, He cannot.

paragraphs.text: You see, everybody in this universe is within Parama Puruśa. He sees everybody within His mind, and because everybody is within His mind, He cannot hate a mental figure of His. So everybody should know that He is not an object of hatred, or object of – what should I say – compassion. You're not an object of compassion, either. It is your right, it is your birthright. You get help from the Supreme Father. To attain the supreme state of bliss is your birthright. You will get it from your Father as a birthright, and not as a mark of compassion.
summary: You see, everybody in this universe is within Parama Puruśa.
It is your right, it is your birthright.
You will get it from your Father as a birthright, and not as a mark of compassion.

paragraphs.text: So Parama Puruśa cannot do these two things. That's why I said that the arena of spirituality is based on Divine love. You may or may not be a learned person. You may or may not have a good history. Your only qualification is that you are the affectionate progeny of the Supreme Progenitor. You are His object of affection. Even if you forget Him He won't forget you. He cannot forget you, because everything in this Universe is His mental creation. And as long as His mind is there, you are within His mind.
summary: So Parama Puruśa cannot do these two things.
Your only qualification is that you are the affectionate progeny of the Supreme Progenitor.
And as long as His mind is there, you are within His mind.

paragraphs.text: He cannot say, “Get out, get out! I don't want to see your face.” He cannot say that, because in that case you will ask Him, “O Lord, you say, 'Get out,' but where am I to go? I would always be within Your mind. And if You say, 'Get out, go beyond the periphery of My mind,' then certainly O Lord, You are not infinite because there is something beyond Your mind.”
summary: He cannot say, “Get out, get out!
” He cannot say that, because in that case you will ask Him, “O Lord, you say, 'Get out,' but where am I to go?
And if You say, 'Get out, go beyond the periphery of My mind,' then certainly O Lord, You are not infinite because there is something beyond Your mind.

paragraphs.text: “So just to maintain the prestige and dignity of Your name, You are to tolerate what I do and what I think. And that's why it is Your duty to guide me. I am Your son, I am Your daughter. I am to do according to Your dictates.”
summary: “So just to maintain the prestige and dignity of Your name, You are to tolerate what I do and what I think.
I am Your son, I am Your daughter.
I am to do according to Your dictates.

paragraphs.text: And not only is this birthright enjoyed by human beings, but by all living creatures. Not only living creatures, but by all animate and inanimate objects. From the mighty mammoth to the small blade of grass, everybody enjoys his birthright. Nobody is insignificant. Nobody is unimportant.
summary: And not only is this birthright enjoyed by human beings, but by all living creatures.
From the mighty mammoth to the small blade of grass, everybody enjoys his birthright.
Nobody is unimportant.

paragraphs.text: Disparity may be encouraged by a defective social order, or by defective isms, but disparity is never supported or encouraged by the Father. The Father's love is for all, so nobody is helpless. Nobody is shelterless. And nobody's future is sealed forever. So in the realm of spirituality you should remember that Divine love is the guiding point, is the desideratum.
summary: Disparity may be encouraged by a defective social order, or by defective isms, but disparity is never supported or encouraged by the Father.
Nobody is shelterless.
So in the realm of spirituality you should remember that Divine love is the guiding point, is the desideratum.

paragraphs.text: One may or may not establish oneself in the actional field. One may or may not establish oneself in the field of intellectuality. One may or may not establish oneself in the mundane sphere. But one must not forget this fact – that the Supreme Entity is with you, and loves you like anything. And the only goal of one's propensities must be Him. That is, all the propensities of the human mind should be goaded unto the Supreme Existence. Humanity must not be engaged in actional infighting or intellectual extravaganza. Man's origin, man's starting-point, is in Divine love, and his culminating point, his terminating point, lies in Divine existence. It is the Supreme truth of this universe.
summary: One may or may not establish oneself in the actional field.
And the only goal of one's propensities must be Him.
It is the Supreme truth of this universe.

chapters.title: The Only Cult

paragraphs.text: Intellectuals and scholars say that one may attain salvation by dint of one's knowledge and intellect. Those who are Karma Yogiis, that is, those who follow the path of actional cult, say that by dint of action one will attain salvation. (Salvation means emancipation of permanent nature.)
summary: Intellectuals and scholars say that one may attain salvation by dint of one's knowledge and intellect.
Those who are Karma Yogiis, that is, those who follow the path of actional cult, say that by dint of action one will attain salvation.
(Salvation means emancipation of permanent nature.

paragraphs.text: Now you know all are children of the Supreme Father. All the children of the same father cannot have the same intellectual standard – it is an impossibility. But that doesn't mean that those who are intellectually backward won't get His bliss or Grace. So this idea is a defective one – that one is to attain Him by dint of one's intellectual knowledge or intellectual stamina. It is a defective idea. A father cannot neglect his son who is intellectually backward.
summary: Now you know all are children of the Supreme Father.
So this idea is a defective one – that one is to attain Him by dint of one's intellectual knowledge or intellectual stamina.
A father cannot neglect his son who is intellectually backward.

paragraphs.text: Not only this. Till recently there was a defective idea in all the corners and amongst all the groups of people on the earth, that males are blessed beings and not females. In your family life, you know, you feel, that the parents cannot have any sense of disparity in their mind regarding their sons and daughters. Both are equally important, both are equally loving. I said my sons and my daughters are just like two hands of mine. They are just like wings of a bird. A bird having one wing cannot fly.
summary: Till recently there was a defective idea in all the corners and amongst all the groups of people on the earth, that males are blessed beings and not females.
I said my sons and my daughters are just like two hands of mine.
A bird having one wing cannot fly.

paragraphs.text: Now the days of those defective ideas are gone. All are equally blessed human beings, and those ideas cherished by those intellectuals, that by dint of one's intellect, one will get Him, are not only defective but foolish ideas. Similarly, the idea that by dint of actional cult one is to attain Him – this is also a defective idea because in the realm of actionality all have not got equal status. A weak boy, or say a weak girl, physically weak or mentally weak or even weak in spiritual vitality, has also got the birth-right to attain salvation.
summary: Now the days of those defective ideas are gone.
Similarly, the idea that by dint of actional cult one is to attain Him – this is also a defective idea because in the realm of actionality all have not got equal status.
A weak boy, or say a weak girl, physically weak or mentally weak or even weak in spiritual vitality, has also got the birth-right to attain salvation.

paragraphs.text: First, what is the meaning of salvation? Salvation means becoming one with Him, and each and every child of the Cosmic Father has equal right to sit on His lap. There cannot be any differentiation.
summary: First, what is the meaning of salvation?
Salvation means becoming one with Him, and each and every child of the Cosmic Father has equal right to sit on His lap.
There cannot be any differentiation.

paragraphs.text: Now what's the guiding factor? Neither intellectuality nor the actional faculty is the guiding factor. Then what's the guiding factor? The guiding factor is that all your ideals, all your propensities, all your thought waves, are to be goaded unto Him. That is, the cult of devotion is the only cult. There cannot be any second cult in the realm of spirituality.
summary: Now what's the guiding factor?
The guiding factor is that all your ideals, all your propensities, all your thought waves, are to be goaded unto Him.
There cannot be any second cult in the realm of spirituality.

paragraphs.text: Mokśakárańasamagryáḿ Bhaktireva Gariiyasi.
summary: Mokśakárańasamagryáḿ Bhaktireva Gariiyasi.

paragraphs.text: The intellectual giant of India, about 1300 years ago, in the post-Buddhistic era, was Shankaracharya. He says – he was a giant intellectual – he said amongst all the approaches, amongst all the cults, the best one is the cult of devotion. So that aspirant is the blessed one who has developed this cult of devotion. You may or may not be an intellectual, you may or may not be established in the actional faculty. But if you can develop love for Him, devotion for Him, you are sure to be successful.
summary: The intellectual giant of India, about 1300 years ago, in the post-Buddhistic era, was Shankaracharya.
So that aspirant is the blessed one who has developed this cult of devotion.
But if you can develop love for Him, devotion for Him, you are sure to be successful.

paragraphs.text: Now how to develop this kind of devotion? The idea is that the All, the entire Universe, is His object, and He is the Supreme Subject. He sees everything and you do not see Him. Now how can He be objectivated when He is the Supreme Subjectivity? The idea, the spirit or the secret to develop devotional cult is to think, while doing anything, while doing any mundane duty or doing any spiritual practice – you should always remember that He is Subject, He is seeing what you are doing. He is hearing what you are thinking. You cannot do anything secretly. He is always with you.
summary: Now how to develop this kind of devotion?

The idea, the spirit or the secret to develop devotional cult is to think, while doing anything, while doing any mundane duty or doing any spiritual practice – you should always remember that He is Subject, He is seeing what you are doing.
He is always with you.

paragraphs.text: This idea has got one advantage and one disadvantage. The disadvantage is that you cannot even think secretly. All your thoughts are tape-recorded by Him. You cannot think secretly. And the advantage is that you are never alone; He is always with you. You are never helpless, you are never shelterless, you are never weak, you are the strongest personality of the universe, because the Supreme Entity is always with you.
summary: This idea has got one advantage and one disadvantage.
You cannot think secretly.
You are never helpless, you are never shelterless, you are never weak, you are the strongest personality of the universe, because the Supreme Entity is always with you.

chapters.title: Shortening the Radius

paragraphs.text: You know there is nothing disorderly in this Universe. Everything moves as per certain rules. In this solar system of ours the sun is the nucleus, and so many planets are moving around the sun. In this earthly system the earth is the nucleus, the moon is moving around it. Similarly, in the atomic system also there is the nucleus and electrons moving around the nucleus.
summary: You know there is nothing disorderly in this Universe.
In this solar system of ours the sun is the nucleus, and so many planets are moving around the sun.
Similarly, in the atomic system also there is the nucleus and electrons moving around the nucleus.

paragraphs.text: In our Cosmic order Parama Puruśa is the Nucleus, and so many animate and inanimate objects are moving around Him, knowingly or unknowingly. In the case of human beings, they are moving, they are dancing, knowingly. And in the case of other animals, and other less-developed living beings, and also in the case of inanimate objects, they are also moving, they are also dancing, but unknowingly, unconsciously.
summary: In our Cosmic order Parama Puruśa is the Nucleus, and so many animate and inanimate objects are moving around Him, knowingly or unknowingly.
In the case of human beings, they are moving, they are dancing, knowingly.
And in the case of other animals, and other less-developed living beings, and also in the case of inanimate objects, they are also moving, they are also dancing, but unknowingly, unconsciously.

paragraphs.text: Even in the case of human beings, when they move around Parama Puruśa, one person moves, one person dances, unknowingly, another person knowingly. Those who are dancing, those who are moving, knowingly, always try to lessen the length of their radii.
summary: Even in the case of human beings, when they move around Parama Puruśa, one person moves, one person dances, unknowingly, another person knowingly.
Those who are dancing, those who are moving, knowingly, always try to lessen the length of their radii.
Those who are dancing, those who are moving, knowingly, always try to lessen the length of their radii.

paragraphs.text: Each and every individual has its own radius, and a spiritual aspirant – what a spiritual aspirant does – he always tries to lessen the length of the radius. Moving like this, [demonstrates with hands], having a particular radius. Those who move unknowingly – the radius remains unchanged, or even, due to their mean propensities, may increase like this [demonstrates].
summary: Each and every individual has its own radius, and a spiritual aspirant – what a spiritual aspirant does – he always tries to lessen the length of the radius.
Moving like this, [demonstrates with hands], having a particular radius.
Those who move unknowingly – the radius remains unchanged, or even, due to their mean propensities, may increase like this [demonstrates].

paragraphs.text: And in the case of spiritual aspirants, what happens? Coming nearer, coming nearer, coming closer – and when a person comes into the closest proximity he becomes one with the Nucleus, and that becoming one with the Nucleus is the stage of salvation.
summary: And in the case of spiritual aspirants, what happens?
Coming nearer, coming nearer, coming closer – and when a person comes into the closest proximity he becomes one with the Nucleus, and that becoming one with the Nucleus is the stage of salvation.
Coming nearer, coming nearer, coming closer – and when a person comes into the closest proximity he becomes one with the Nucleus, and that becoming one with the Nucleus is the stage of salvation.

paragraphs.text: Now so many entities, so many individuals, are moving around Him, and they are associated with so many physical structures – long, short, white, black, learned, illiterate – so many structures - but the common goal is the Nucleus, Parama Puruśa. There is no shyness, no hatred, no complex, because that Nucleus is the bigger “I” of everybody; that Nucleus is the Supreme Progenitor of everybody. Now each and every entity has its own Saḿskara. “Saḿskara” means “reactive momenta”. The action you did the reaction to which you have not undergone – such an action not satisfied by the reaction is known as what? In the plural, “reactive momenta”. And beings are to move according to their reactive momenta or Saḿskára.
summary: Now so many entities, so many individuals, are moving around Him, and they are associated with so many physical structures – long, short, white, black, learned, illiterate – so many structures - but the common goal is the Nucleus, Parama Puruśa.
“Saḿskara” means “reactive momenta”.
And beings are to move according to their reactive momenta or Saḿskára.

paragraphs.text: Now this movement around the Nucleus is life, rather, human life. Everybody moves, but in the case of humans, the movement is knowingly. We are moving around Parama Puruśa. The human being knows; other animals do not know; and there lies the fundamental difference between a man and an animal. So if, after getting a human structure, a human mind and an objectivated human soul, anybody doesn't move knowingly, he or she is worse than an animal, because an animal lacks in the developed mind. It cannot understand or practise spirituality, which a man can do.
summary: Now this movement around the Nucleus is life, rather, human life.
The human being knows; other animals do not know; and there lies the fundamental difference between a man and an animal.
It cannot understand or practise spirituality, which a man can do.

paragraphs.text: Now wherever a few spiritual aspirants assemble, whenever there is a gathering of a few spiritual aspirants, I said they shouldn't waste their time in idle gossiping, they should utilize their time in Kiirtana, because when the Kiirtana is done a spiritual environment is created then and there, and as soon as the spiritual environment is created, the Supreme Nucleus, Parama Puruśa, will then and there shift His headquarters to among those aspirants; because the centre of the Nucleus is above the periphery of time, space and person. He may shift it anywhere, wherever, whenever, so desired by Him.
summary: Now wherever a few spiritual aspirants assemble, whenever there is a gathering of a few spiritual aspirants, I said they shouldn't waste their time in idle gossiping, they should utilize their time in Kiirtana, because when the Kiirtana is done a spiritual environment is created then and there, and as soon as the spiritual environment is created, the Supreme Nucleus, Parama Puruśa, will then and there shift His headquarters to among those aspirants; because the centre of the Nucleus is above the periphery of time, space and person.
He may shift it anywhere, wherever, whenever, so desired by Him.
He may shift it anywhere, wherever, whenever, so desired by Him.

paragraphs.text: Now what is His Grace? The moving entity becomes one with the Nucleus, how? It depends on His Grace. It doesn't depend on human logic, or human intellect; it depends on His Grace. What is His Grace? Mr. A may say, “Why am I not enjoying His Grace?” Mr. B may say, “I am enjoying His Grace.” But what's the fact? The Grace is everywhere, but you know, just like rainfall – when it rains what happens? If you have an umbrella above your head you won't be drenched. And if you remove the umbrella you will be drenched. So in the case of Divine Grace, it is like rainfall, but there is an umbrella of vanity upon your head, that's why you are not drenched. Remove the umbrella of vanity and you will be drenched; then you will enjoy His Grace.
summary: Now what is His Grace?
” But what's the fact?
Remove the umbrella of vanity and you will be drenched; then you will enjoy His Grace.

paragraphs.text: And that's the secret, and when you are enjoying the Grace, what will happen? The radius will be shortened, and in this very life you will become one with your Goal, your Nucleus. This Nucleus knows no artificial barrier, nor isms, countries or philosophies. This Nucleus knows that the moving entities are My children – they want to come and sit on My lap.
summary: And that's the secret, and when you are enjoying the Grace, what will happen?
This Nucleus knows no artificial barrier, nor isms, countries or philosophies.
This Nucleus knows that the moving entities are My children – they want to come and sit on My lap.

chapters.title: The Starting Point and the Last Point

paragraphs.text: Whenever something is done, the doer should follow certain rules and regulations, and the authority that creates those rules and regulations is known as the “controller.” Here in this Universe of ours, so many actions are done, there are so many manifestations and expressions, so many waves are emanated from so many sources; so there must a strong controller.
summary: Whenever something is done, the doer should follow certain rules and regulations, and the authority that creates those rules and regulations is known as the “controller.
” Here in this Universe of ours, so many actions are done, there are so many manifestations and expressions, so many waves are emanated from so many sources; so there must a strong controller.
” Here in this Universe of ours, so many actions are done, there are so many manifestations and expressions, so many waves are emanated from so many sources; so there must a strong controller.

paragraphs.text: But that strong controller must not be a machine, nor should he be of mechanical order. He must be a loving entity.
summary: But that strong controller must not be a machine, nor should he be of mechanical order.
He must be a loving entity.
He must be a loving entity.

paragraphs.text: Now there are so many controllers in different fields and different spheres of our life. There are so many different expressions, so there are different controllers also. But above all controllers there is the Supreme Controller.
summary: Now there are so many controllers in different fields and different spheres of our life.
There are so many different expressions, so there are different controllers also.
But above all controllers there is the Supreme Controller.

paragraphs.text: In Saḿskrta, “controller” is “Iishvara”, and the Supreme Controller is called “Maheshvara.” Now the rules and regulations of lower controllers may or may not be of perfect order, but the rules and regulations of the Supreme Controller must be of perfect order. Otherwise the equilibrium or equipoise of this Universe will be lost.
summary: In Saḿskrta, “controller” is “Iishvara”, and the Supreme Controller is called “Maheshvara.
” Now the rules and regulations of lower controllers may or may not be of perfect order, but the rules and regulations of the Supreme Controller must be of perfect order.
Otherwise the equilibrium or equipoise of this Universe will be lost.

paragraphs.text: So our first duty as disciplined human beings is to do as per the desire of the Supreme Controller, of that Maheshvara. Just doing according to the desire of that Controller is a must for all spiritual aspirants. But while obeying Him, While doing as per His desire, one should always remember that Supreme Entity is not the boss; that Supreme Entity is the loving Father. The relationship is not official, the relationship is purely personal.
summary: So our first duty as disciplined human beings is to do as per the desire of the Supreme Controller, of that Maheshvara.
But while obeying Him, While doing as per His desire, one should always remember that Supreme Entity is not the boss; that Supreme Entity is the loving Father.
The relationship is not official, the relationship is purely personal.

paragraphs.text: You know if there is an impersonal entity controlling everything, having no link with you, in that case the psychology of discipline won't be created, because in that case an order is followed or obeyed or adhered to due to a fear complex – but in the field of spirituality there must not be any complex, neither fear complex nor shy complex nor any other complex. So the scriptures saying that if you do not obey Him you will go to Hell, like this, these scriptures are the worst enemy of human society. Because these scriptures create a complex, a fear complex, in the human mind, and that fear complex creates disparity in this human society.
summary: You know if there is an impersonal entity controlling everything, having no link with you, in that case the psychology of discipline won't be created, because in that case an order is followed or obeyed or adhered to due to a fear complex – but in the field of spirituality there must not be any complex, neither fear complex nor shy complex nor any other complex.
So the scriptures saying that if you do not obey Him you will go to Hell, like this, these scriptures are the worst enemy of human society.
Because these scriptures create a complex, a fear complex, in the human mind, and that fear complex creates disparity in this human society.

paragraphs.text: This human society is one. It is a singular entity. It cannot be divided; it must not be divided; and we won't allow any entity to create any fissiparous tendency in this human society.
summary: This human society is one.
It is a singular entity.
It cannot be divided; it must not be divided; and we won't allow any entity to create any fissiparous tendency in this human society.

paragraphs.text: Whatever a man is to do in his spiritual life he is to do – why? Because he is in love with the Supreme Entity. Love is the first word, love is the starting point, and love is the last point. And scriptures have no moral right to create a fear complex in the human mind.
summary: Whatever a man is to do in his spiritual life he is to do – why?
Love is the first word, love is the starting point, and love is the last point.
And scriptures have no moral right to create a fear complex in the human mind.

chapters.title: Dance, Mudrá and Tantra

paragraphs.text: You know that even before Sadáshiva there was dance, there was music; people used to sing, also; but everything was in a disorderly manner. The dexterous hands of Sadáshiva made it a science – rather, an artistic science.
summary: You know that even before Sadáshiva there was dance, there was music; people used to sing, also; but everything was in a disorderly manner.
The dexterous hands of Sadáshiva made it a science – rather, an artistic science.
The dexterous hands of Sadáshiva made it a science – rather, an artistic science.

paragraphs.text: It is not an easy job to dance properly and correctly. The fundamental requirements, or the fundamental spirit, of dance, instrumental music, and song were brought within the framework of science by Sadáshiva, and that is why He is also known as “Nat́arája”: “Nat́arája” means “King of the Dancers”. (And another name of Sadáshiva is “Nádatanu”, that is, “music personified”.)
summary: It is not an easy job to dance properly and correctly.

The fundamental requirements, or the fundamental spirit, of dance, instrumental music, and song were brought within the framework of science by Sadáshiva, and that is why He is also known as “Nat́arája”: “Nat́arája” means “King of the Dancers”.
(And another name of Sadáshiva is “Nádatanu”, that is, “music personified”.

paragraphs.text: Dance is a highly-developed art. In the Oriental variety of music, you know, three items come within the fold of saḿgiita, or music: dance, song, and instrumental music. The collective name in Sanskrit is saḿgiita. Lord Sadáshiva brought everything within the framework of science, and just now I called it “artistic science”.
summary: Dance is a highly-developed art.
The collective name in Sanskrit is saḿgiita.
Lord Sadáshiva brought everything within the framework of science, and just now I called it “artistic science”.

paragraphs.text: In the Oriental variety of dance there are several mudrás, that is, postures. When giving something to a living being, the mudrá is like this [demonstrates]. When giving something to something past, not present in the world, the mudrá is like this [demonstrates]. The “don't fear” mudrá is like this. The “take what you want” mudrá is like this. The “come forward” mudrá is like this. The “be serpentine” mudrá is like this. “Be subtle, maintain a link with the earth” is like this. There are so many mudrás used in the Oriental variety of dance. It is not an easy job to learn it, but rather a very difficult job.
summary: In the Oriental variety of dance there are several mudrás, that is, postures.
The “come forward” mudrá is like this.
It is not an easy job to learn it, but rather a very difficult job.

paragraphs.text: Now the fundamentality, or rather the primordial phase of Oriental dance, is táńd́ava. It is not a very easy job either. The knees must cross the navel. When they cross the navel it is called Brahma táńd́ava. When they cross the anáhata [mid-point of the chest] it is called Viśńu táńd́ava. When they cross this portion [indicates the throat], it is called Rudra táńd́ava. It is very difficult to dance Rudra táńd́ava. It requires long practice.
summary: Now the fundamentality, or rather the primordial phase of Oriental dance, is táńd́ava.
When they cross the anáhata [mid-point of the chest] it is called Viśńu táńd́ava.
It requires long practice.

paragraphs.text: That is why Lord Sadáshiva is known as Nat́arája. And when these boys [indicates them] were dancing, it was just like a picture of Nat́arája in táńd́ava mudrá. It is called táńd́ava; táńd́ava is a mudrá.
summary: That is why Lord Sadáshiva is known as Nat́arája.
And when these boys [indicates them] were dancing, it was just like a picture of Nat́arája in táńd́ava mudrá.
It is called táńd́ava; táńd́ava is a mudrá.

paragraphs.text: Why is it called táńd́ava? In Sanskrit tańd́ means “to jump”. Tańd́u means “of jumping habit”. Táńd́ava means “having the use of tańd́u, the use of jumping”. But jumping in the proper style, not in a disorderly manner. You should learn it properly in a disciplined way.
summary: Why is it called táńd́ava?
Táńd́ava means “having the use of tańd́u, the use of jumping”.
You should learn it properly in a disciplined way.

paragraphs.text: And táńd́ava represents life; you know Tantra is a cult of life, it is not a cult of death. For Tantra you should be strong physically, mentally and spiritually. First in the present tense; Lord Shiva says all your expressions, all your manifestations, must be based on the present tense. So this táńd́ava is the starting phase of Tantra.
summary: And táńd́ava represents life; you know Tantra is a cult of life, it is not a cult of death.
First in the present tense; Lord Shiva says all your expressions, all your manifestations, must be based on the present tense.
So this táńd́ava is the starting phase of Tantra.

paragraphs.text: This táńd́ava I said represents life, it represents vitality. There are so many forces that want to destroy you, so many forces forces that are inimical to you by nature. Say a snake – a snake is a born enemy. There are many such born enemies. As Tantra represents life, táńd́ava says that one's spirit should be based on vitality, based on the principle of survival.
summary: This táńd́ava I said represents life, it represents vitality.
Say a snake – a snake is a born enemy.
As Tantra represents life, táńd́ava says that one's spirit should be based on vitality, based on the principle of survival.

paragraphs.text: This human skull represents death. You are surrounded by death, but you must not be defeated, you must not develop the psychology of fear or defeatism. So the knife is with you to fight against death. ( 1 ) Yours is a fight for survival. In the daytime one may also use a snake to represent death – not an ordinary snake, but a venomous snake. In India our boys dance with a snake. But at nighttime neither a skull nor a snake will be visible. Here there is light, they will be visible, but in a burial ground, in a cremation ground, where there is darkness, a snake or skull will not be visible. There you may use fire to represent death.
summary: This human skull represents death.
In the daytime one may also use a snake to represent death – not an ordinary snake, but a venomous snake.
There you may use fire to represent death.

paragraphs.text: This is the spirit of Tantra. To fight, to fight for survival. It is normal life moving towards the supreme state of abnormality.
summary: This is the spirit of Tantra.
To fight, to fight for survival.
It is normal life moving towards the supreme state of abnormality.

paragraphs.text: Lord Shiva started this táńd́ava dance, and his spouse, Párvatii, started the lalita dance, lalita mármika. What you did just at present while singing kiirtana, that is called lalita. Lalita represents that now we are enjoying bliss, we are in a happy mood. We are in a happy mood, and the hands should be above ninety degrees. Do you follow? I think you followed me. Lalita represents a happy mood, and it was invented by Párvatii, Lord Shiva's spouse. Lalita helps people in their spiritual progress and psychic expansion.
summary: Lord Shiva started this táńd́ava dance, and his spouse, Párvatii, started the lalita dance, lalita mármika.
We are in a happy mood, and the hands should be above ninety degrees.
Lalita helps people in their spiritual progress and psychic expansion.

paragraphs.text: Now the devas, the Tantrics of that era, about seven thousand years ago, learned táńd́ava and lalita and wanted there to be a musical expression for the general public. That is your RAWA. ( 2 )
summary: Now the devas, the Tantrics of that era, about seven thousand years ago, learned táńd́ava and lalita and wanted there to be a musical expression for the general public.

paragraphs.text: For the general public there was the middle course. This middle course is called madhyama márga in Sanskrit, majhjhimá mágga in Buddhist scriptures. And that path, where the subtle aspects of spirituality combined with the subtle aspects of vitality, was represented by [tála].
summary: For the general public there was the middle course.
This middle course is called madhyama márga in Sanskrit, majhjhimá mágga in Buddhist scriptures.
And that path, where the subtle aspects of spirituality combined with the subtle aspects of vitality, was represented by [tála].

paragraphs.text: A middle course was invented, and in Oriental music it is called tála. Oriental music is based on tála. Tála means – the first sound of táńd́ava is tá, and the first sound of lalita is la – tá plus la.
summary: A middle course was invented, and in Oriental music it is called tála.
Oriental music is based on tála.
Tála means – the first sound of táńd́ava is tá, and the first sound of lalita is la – tá plus la.

paragraphs.text: Yes, this was the origin. And on the basis of tála, Oriental music invented so many rágas and ráginiis, so many tunes and sub-tunes, in the hoary past.
summary: Yes, this was the origin.
And on the basis of tála, Oriental music invented so many rágas and ráginiis, so many tunes and sub-tunes, in the hoary past.
And on the basis of tála, Oriental music invented so many rágas and ráginiis, so many tunes and sub-tunes, in the hoary past.

paragraphs.text: Now in all of South Asia and Southeast Asia the music is based on this tála. It is the happy blending of táńd́ava and lalita, and in it there are two main offshoots. One is known as the Áryávarta offshoot, from Persia to Vietnam, and the other is the Dákśińátya offshoot of all South India, Ceylon, Indonesia, Malaysia and up to Australia.
summary: Now in all of South Asia and Southeast Asia the music is based on this tála.
It is the happy blending of táńd́ava and lalita, and in it there are two main offshoots.
One is known as the Áryávarta offshoot, from Persia to Vietnam, and the other is the Dákśińátya offshoot of all South India, Ceylon, Indonesia, Malaysia and up to Australia.

paragraphs.text: This is the science, and this science was invented by Sadáshiva. It is to be learned with proper care and proper respect. These boys displayed excellently what I am trying to say. I am extremely pleased with the sweetness they displayed.
summary: This is the science, and this science was invented by Sadáshiva.
These boys displayed excellently what I am trying to say.
I am extremely pleased with the sweetness they displayed.

footnotes.text: ( 1 ) Táńd́ava is performed with a skull, a snake, or a torch in the left hand, and a knife in the right hand. –Eds.

chapters.title: The Supreme Witness and the Great Thief

paragraphs.text: While explaining the inner significance of Táńd́ava, I was saying one of the names of Sadáshiva is “Nat́arája” that is, “the king of dancers.” There are so many names, so many attributes, but occult science says He is beyond the periphery of all attributions, beyond the scope of all qualifications.
summary: While explaining the inner significance of Táńd́ava, I was saying one of the names of Sadáshiva is “Nat́arája” that is, “the king of dancers.
” There are so many names, so many attributes, but occult science says He is beyond the periphery of all attributions, beyond the scope of all qualifications.
” There are so many names, so many attributes, but occult science says He is beyond the periphery of all attributions, beyond the scope of all qualifications.

paragraphs.text: Why is He beyond the scope of all attributions? There are two reasons. One is that He is the creator of everything, so He is the creator of qualifications also, attributions also. So how can He be within the binding scope of those principles, of those qualifications? And certainly He is beyond the reach of these qualifications. In Saḿskrta, qualification or attribution is called “Guńa”, and He is called “Guńátiita”, that is, beyond the bondage of any Guńa.
summary: Why is He beyond the scope of all attributions?
So how can He be within the binding scope of those principles, of those qualifications?
In Saḿskrta, qualification or attribution is called “Guńa”, and He is called “Guńátiita”, that is, beyond the bondage of any Guńa.

paragraphs.text: And there is another reason also, and that is – suppose a man is an MA in thirty subjects. Still, he cannot be an MA in an infinite number of subjects. Human possibilities have certain limitations. But He is beyond all limitations. So how can one say that He has got this quality or that quality? That's why He is Guńátiita.
summary: And there is another reason also, and that is – suppose a man is an MA in thirty subjects.
But He is beyond all limitations.
That's why He is Guńátiita.

paragraphs.text: Once upon a time some devotees approached one poet, one Saḿskrta poet, to get him to write something regarding the qualifications of Parama Puruśa. He said, “Yes, I'll write something, I'll do the duty within a few seconds.” Then that poet wrote a Shloka in Saḿskrta, that is, a poem in Saḿskrta. Poems are called “Shlokas” in Saḿskrta. And he wrote,
summary: Once upon a time some devotees approached one poet, one Saḿskrta poet, to get him to write something regarding the qualifications of Parama Puruśa.
” Then that poet wrote a Shloka in Saḿskrta, that is, a poem in Saḿskrta.
Poems are called “Shlokas” in Saḿskrta.

paragraphs.text: Asita girivara kajjalaḿ sindhupátre Surataruvara shákhá likhanii patra muravii Likhitvá yadi grhitvá sáradá sarvakálaḿ Tadápi tava guńanáma iisha páraḿ na yáti.
summary: Asita girivara kajjalaḿ sindhupátre Surataruvara shákhá likhanii patra muravii Likhitvá yadi grhitvá sáradá sarvakálaḿ Tadápi tava guńanáma iisha páraḿ na yáti.

paragraphs.text: Now if we want to write about His qualifications we require ink, we require paper, and we require – what? We require one writer. To write about His qualifications we require these things, So the poet said, “If we get the mighty Himalayas as an ink tablet – we require ink – and as an ink pot, all the oceans of the world; and then a pen.”
summary: Now if we want to write about His qualifications we require ink, we require paper, and we require – what?
We require one writer.

To write about His qualifications we require these things, So the poet said, “If we get the mighty Himalayas as an ink tablet – we require ink – and as an ink pot, all the oceans of the world; and then a pen.

paragraphs.text: The biggest imaginary tree of Heaven is known as 'Párijáta'. “If we use that tree as the pen and if this entire lithosphere is used as paper – and who is to write? If the imaginary goddess of learning, the mythological goddess of learning, Minerva, writes with this ink tablet, ink pot, paper and pen – for how many days? For an innumerable number of days – even then it won't be possible for her to write all His qualifications.”
summary: The biggest imaginary tree of Heaven is known as 'Párijáta'.
If the imaginary goddess of learning, the mythological goddess of learning, Minerva, writes with this ink tablet, ink pot, paper and pen – for how many days?
For an innumerable number of days – even then it won't be possible for her to write all His qualifications.

paragraphs.text: He is beyond the periphery of all qualifications. That's why He's “Guńátiita.” Nat́arája is one of His qualifications, it is not everything. He is also called “Parama Puruśa.”
summary: He is beyond the periphery of all qualifications.
” Nat́arája is one of His qualifications, it is not everything.
He is also called “Parama Puruśa.

paragraphs.text: What's the meaning of “Parama Puruśa”? What's the meaning of “Puruśa”?
summary: What's the meaning of “Parama Puruśa”?
What's the meaning of “Puruśa”?
What's the meaning of “Puruśa”?

paragraphs.text: You know this physical body, this physical body is what? It is one of your cells, it is a physical cell. And within this physical cell, there is the psychic cell. And there is the spiritual body. Now the entity that always remains with you, within your physical structure, within your psychic structure, and also closely associated with your spiritual structure, is Puruśa. “Pura” means “representing the structure”; the entity who is always present with you, within your structure, is Puruśa.
summary: You know this physical body, this physical body is what?
And there is the spiritual body.
“Pura” means “representing the structure”; the entity who is always present with you, within your structure, is Puruśa.

paragraphs.text: Now each and every entity, each and every living being and each and every inanimate object, has Puruśa in it. Some objects are animate, due to the presence of afferent and efferent nerves, due to the presence of so many organs; and when Puruśa is there those organs can function. In the case of inanimate objects – stones, sand, earth, water – due to the absence of those nerves and organs they cannot realize anything, they cannot feel anything, they cannot witness anything. But the Puruśa is there. Puruśa is present everywhere.
summary: Now each and every entity, each and every living being and each and every inanimate object, has Puruśa in it.
In the case of inanimate objects – stones, sand, earth, water – due to the absence of those nerves and organs they cannot realize anything, they cannot feel anything, they cannot witness anything.
Puruśa is present everywhere.

paragraphs.text: Now the individual Puruśas lying covert within your existence are unit Puruśas, your individual “I's”, your little “I's”. And the Supreme is called “Parama Puruśa.”
summary: Now the individual Puruśas lying covert within your existence are unit Puruśas, your individual “I's”, your little “I's”.
And the Supreme is called “Parama Puruśa.
And the Supreme is called “Parama Puruśa.

paragraphs.text: “Parama”, the word “Parama” has two meanings, two significances. One meaning is “Supreme”, another meaning is “the final Para”. What is “Para”? Suppose you are seeing an elephant. Here you are the subject and the elephant is the object. Now, because the elephant is the object, we say the elephant is the Apara entity and you, the seer, are the Para entity.
summary: “Parama”, the word “Parama” has two meanings, two significances.
Suppose you are seeing an elephant.
Now, because the elephant is the object, we say the elephant is the Apara entity and you, the seer, are the Para entity.

paragraphs.text: Now who's seeing? Your eyes are seeing. Why are your eyes seeing, how are your eyes seeing? Because your mind wants it. So in the next phase, that is, in the first inner phase, who is the Apara and who is the Para? The eyes are Apara, object, and the mind is Para, subject. Then in the next inner phase the mind is Apara and your Átman, the witnessing entity, is Para.
summary: Your eyes are seeing.
So in the next phase, that is, in the first inner phase, who is the Apara and who is the Para?
Then in the next inner phase the mind is Apara and your Átman, the witnessing entity, is Para.

paragraphs.text: But you know Parama Puruśa is seeing everything. What your Átman is witnessing, that thing is also witnessed by Parama Puruśa. So your Átman is Apara and the Supreme Entity is Para. So He is the Supreme Para, that's why He's called “Parama Puruśa”. This is the exact meaning of the term “Parama Puruśa”.
summary: But you know Parama Puruśa is seeing everything.
So your Átman is Apara and the Supreme Entity is Para.
This is the exact meaning of the term “Parama Puruśa”.

paragraphs.text: Now this “Parama Puruśa” is the Supreme Witnessing Entity. What your individual Puruśa is seeing or is witnessing or is feeling – everything is being witnessed by the Supreme Entity.
summary: Now this “Parama Puruśa” is the Supreme Witnessing Entity.
What your individual Puruśa is seeing or is witnessing or is feeling – everything is being witnessed by the Supreme Entity.
What your individual Puruśa is seeing or is witnessing or is feeling – everything is being witnessed by the Supreme Entity.

paragraphs.text: Now how is everything being witnessed by the Supreme Entity? Suppose you are creating a rhinoceros in your mind and that rhinoceros is moving within your mind. Whatever that rhinoceros is doing, you are seeing. Whatever that rhinoceros is saying, you are hearing. [[And whatever that rhinoceros is thinking you are hearing.]] Whatever the rhinoceros does, there and then it is being witnessed by you. No activities, no thought waves, of that rhinoceros, are a secret for you – you know everything. And whatever is being done in the Universe is nothing but a mental creation of Parama Puruśa. Everything is within His mind. He is the Macrocosm[[, and everything is Microcosm]].
summary: Now how is everything being witnessed by the Supreme Entity?
]] Whatever the rhinoceros does, there and then it is being witnessed by you.
He is the Macrocosm[[, and everything is Microcosm]].

paragraphs.text: So each and every man is moving within His mind. Everything is within Him, nothing is without. Whatever is being done He sees, He knows, He feels. This universe is nothing but a mental projection of that Parama Puruśa.
summary: So each and every man is moving within His mind.
Whatever is being done He sees, He knows, He feels.
This universe is nothing but a mental projection of that Parama Puruśa.

paragraphs.text: Hence He is Parama Puruśa, and because everything is His mental creation, everything, everybody, is – what? His child. He is not the ruler; He is not the administrator; He is not the boss. He is the creator, the generator; He is the operator; and He is the destroyer. When He withdraws His thought waves within Himself then nothing will remain. You came from Him, you are moving within His mind, and finally you will be one with Him. That's why I said that He as generator is represented by “G”; He as operator is represented by “O”; and He as destructor is represented by “D” “G”, “O”, “D”. He is “God”.
summary: Hence He is Parama Puruśa, and because everything is His mental creation, everything, everybody, is – what?
When He withdraws His thought waves within Himself then nothing will remain.
That's why I said that He as generator is represented by “G”; He as operator is represented by “O”; and He as destructor is represented by “D” “G”, “O”, “D”.

paragraphs.text: Now let me explain the meaning of the word “Deva” first. The root word is “Div” The Saḿskrta word is “Deva”. “Deva” means “vibrating faculty”. The entity due to whose presence everything in the Universe vibrates is “Deva” or “Div”, and its Latin adjective is “divine”.
summary: Now let me explain the meaning of the word “Deva” first.
“Deva” means “vibrating faculty”.
The entity due to whose presence everything in the Universe vibrates is “Deva” or “Div”, and its Latin adjective is “divine”.

paragraphs.text: Everything, each and every expression, is represented by a particular type of wave. There are sound waves, there are light waves; some waves may or may not be properly understood or assimilated by your organs. Some sounds are audible, some sounds are not audible. Some of the light waves are visible, some of the light waves are not visible. But all those waves are Devas, because they vibrate the entire creation.
summary: Everything, each and every expression, is represented by a particular type of wave.
Some sounds are audible, some sounds are not audible.
But all those waves are Devas, because they vibrate the entire creation.

paragraphs.text: Now all these waves emanate from a particular source. The source is a singular one, so the source that controls all these Devas, all those vibrations or vibrational faculties, is Mahádeva. “Mahá” means “great”. “The great Deva”. Hence Parama Puruśa is called “Mahádeva”. That is, another name of Parama Puruśa, another name of God, is “Mahádeva”.
summary: Now all these waves emanate from a particular source.
“Mahá” means “great”.
That is, another name of Parama Puruśa, another name of God, is “Mahádeva”.

paragraphs.text: A very popular name is “Hari”. In Saḿskrta the root verb “Har” means “to steal”, and “Hari” means “the stealing agent”.
summary: A very popular name is “Hari”.
In Saḿskrta the root verb “Har” means “to steal”, and “Hari” means “the stealing agent”.
In Saḿskrta the root verb “Har” means “to steal”, and “Hari” means “the stealing agent”.

paragraphs.text: It is fundamentally against Sixteen Points and Yama and Niyama, so how can Parama Puruśa steal? He is stealing, that is, His actions are ultravires to the principles of Sixteen Points, and Yama and Niyama? It is against Asteya.
summary: It is fundamentally against Sixteen Points and Yama and Niyama, so how can Parama Puruśa steal?
He is stealing, that is, His actions are ultravires to the principles of Sixteen Points, and Yama and Niyama?
It is against Asteya.

paragraphs.text: Though He cannot go against the principles of Sixteen Points, Asteya and Yama and Niyama, but the very name says that He is a thief. You heard “Hari” means thief?
summary: Though He cannot go against the principles of Sixteen Points, Asteya and Yama and Niyama, but the very name says that He is a thief.
You heard “Hari” means thief?
You heard “Hari” means thief?

paragraphs.text: Yes, He is a thief, but He is not against Sixteen Points or Yama and Niyama. How can this be? As explained, each and every entity is within His mind; He is the generator, operator and destroyer. Everybody is His, all are His loving children. But you know, whatever a man does, that very man will have to undergo the reactive momenta of his original action or actions. Suppose a man committed so many sins in so many lives; now he will have to undergo the reactions of those actions, of those bad actions. Then for all millions of years he will have to pass through so many troubles, so many pains, so many mental tortures. A father cannot like this, a father cannot think that His children will have to go through so much trouble because of their past bad actions. So what does He want? He wants His sons to give Him – what? The sins committed by them. But the sons will say, the daughters will say, “No, Father, we will give you flowers, we will give you sweets, we will give you so many things; but we can't give you our sins. We can't.”
summary: Yes, He is a thief, but He is not against Sixteen Points or Yama and Niyama.
Then for all millions of years he will have to pass through so many troubles, so many pains, so many mental tortures.
But the sons will say, the daughters will say, “No, Father, we will give you flowers, we will give you sweets, we will give you so many things; but we can't give you our sins.

paragraphs.text: Then what will this loving Father do? He will secretly take away the sins. He is the great thief.
summary: Then what will this loving Father do?
He will secretly take away the sins.
He is the great thief.

chapters.title: Names of the Lord

paragraphs.text: Last night I was explaining the meanings of some spiritual terms, first “Parama Puruśa”, then “Hari”. There is another very popular term and that one is “Keshava.” The word comes from “Keshi.” “Keshi” was the name of a mythological giant.
summary: Last night I was explaining the meanings of some spiritual terms, first “Parama Puruśa”, then “Hari”.
” The word comes from “Keshi.
” “Keshi” was the name of a mythological giant.

paragraphs.text: Actually, what is Keshi? Keshi is the respiratory organ in a disordered form. You know that the mind or mental concentration has a very close relationship with the respiratory organ. When the respiration is [disordered] – the inhalation or exhalation is very [disordered] – the mind becomes restless. When running, inhalation and exhalation are both very [disordered]. So in that state you cannot concentrate your mind. When running, your mind cannot be concentrated because of [disordered] inhalation and exhalation. To correct this, one should try to pause physically and the respiration should be brought under control. Respiration in a disorderly way or disorderly style is called “Keshi.”
summary: Actually, what is Keshi?
When running, inhalation and exhalation are both very [disordered].
Respiration in a disorderly way or disorderly style is called “Keshi.

paragraphs.text: [[“Práńán yamayatyeśah práńáyámah”]] – “By the process of Práńáyáma one is to control the respiration,” and when, by controlling the respiration, one is controlling the mental propensities, the mind will be concentrated. One can do it by a special process, and that system is to be strictly adhered to for proper control over the respiratory organ. And without this control, the mind cannot be concentrated, and without concentration of mind there can be no spiritual progress.
summary: [[“Práńán yamayatyeśah práńáyámah”]] – “By the process of Práńáyáma one is to control the respiration,” and when, by controlling the respiration, one is controlling the mental propensities, the mind will be concentrated.
One can do it by a special process, and that system is to be strictly adhered to for proper control over the respiratory organ.
And without this control, the mind cannot be concentrated, and without concentration of mind there can be no spiritual progress.

paragraphs.text: The Lord by whose Grace one establishes one's control over the respiratory system is “Keshava.”
summary: The Lord by whose Grace one establishes one's control over the respiratory system is “Keshava.

paragraphs.text: Now during Kiirtana what happens? The mind gets automatically concentrated. So Kiirtana helps much in concentrating the mind. And if one who practices Práńáyáma simultaneously practices Kiirtana, he will get double the benefit. So Keshava, the Lord, Parama Puruśa always encourages Kiirtana.
summary: Now during Kiirtana what happens?
So Kiirtana helps much in concentrating the mind.
So Keshava, the Lord, Parama Puruśa always encourages Kiirtana.

paragraphs.text: Now you have understood the meaning of “Keshava”. Another popular name is “Náráyańa”.
summary: Now you have understood the meaning of “Keshava”.
Another popular name is “Náráyańa”.
Another popular name is “Náráyańa”.

paragraphs.text: In the Saḿskrta language the word “Nára” has three meanings. One meaning of “Nára” is “Niira,” that is, “water”. Another meaning of “Nára” is “devotion”. You know, in ancient times, there was a great sage. His name was “Nárada.” “Nárada” means “the man who distributes devotion”. “Nára” means “devotion.” And the third meaning of “Nára” is the Cosmic Operative Principle, the Cosmic creative faculty.
summary: In the Saḿskrta language the word “Nára” has three meanings.
His name was “Nárada.
” And the third meaning of “Nára” is the Cosmic Operative Principle, the Cosmic creative faculty.

paragraphs.text: And “Ayana” means “shelter”. Now who is the shelter of the Cosmic Operative Principle? Who is the shelter of the Cosmic creative faculty? Parama Puruśa. Hence “Náráyańa” means “Parama Puruśa”, the same meaning as “Keshava”.
summary: And “Ayana” means “shelter”.
Who is the shelter of the Cosmic creative faculty?
Hence “Náráyańa” means “Parama Puruśa”, the same meaning as “Keshava”.

paragraphs.text: “Parama Puruśa”, “Hari”, “Náráyańa” have the same meaning. “Water”, “aqua”, “jal”, “pánii”[[, “eau”]] have the same meaning.
summary: “Parama Puruśa”, “Hari”, “Náráyańa” have the same meaning.
“Water”, “aqua”, “jal”, “pánii”[[, “eau”]] have the same meaning.
“Water”, “aqua”, “jal”, “pánii”[[, “eau”]] have the same meaning.

paragraphs.text: Another name is “Mádhava”. In Saḿskrta the word “Má” has three meanings. One meaning of “Má” is simply a negative term, just like “not”, “no”. Another meaning of “Má” is “tongue”. And the third meaning is “Cosmic Operative Principle”. And “Dhava” has two meanings. One meaning is “husband”. Another meaning is “dress”, “cloth”. Now “Mádhava” means “Lord of the Operative Principle”, same as “Náráyańa”: that is, “Parama Puruśa”. So “Mádhava” also means “Parama Puruśa”.
summary: Another name is “Mádhava”.
And “Dhava” has two meanings.
So “Mádhava” also means “Parama Puruśa”.

paragraphs.text: And the very popular name “[[Svádhá]]” or “Khudá” means “the Self Creating Entity”. In old Vedic, “[[Svádhá]]”, in old Iranian, “Khudá”, means “he who creates himself”.
summary: And the very popular name “[[Svádhá]]” or “Khudá” means “the Self Creating Entity”.
In old Vedic, “[[Svádhá]]”, in old Iranian, “Khudá”, means “he who creates himself”.
In old Vedic, “[[Svádhá]]”, in old Iranian, “Khudá”, means “he who creates himself”.

paragraphs.text: Then another popular word is “Ráma”. The word come from the Saḿskrta root “Ram”. “Ram” means “getting pleasure”, “enjoying bliss”. “Ram” is a root verb, not a word. You know, with a root verb, if we add a suffix a word is created, and if we use a prefix, the meaning is changed. With the root verb “ceive”, we may use the prefix “re” – “receive”, or “per” – “perceive”, “con” – “conceive”. Similarly, the word “Ram” is a root verb, not a word. And when it becomes a noun or adjective, it becomes “Ráma”. “Ráma” means the object from which the spiritual aspirant gets pleasure.
summary: Then another popular word is “Ráma”.
You know, with a root verb, if we add a suffix a word is created, and if we use a prefix, the meaning is changed.
“Ráma” means the object from which the spiritual aspirant gets pleasure.

paragraphs.text: It is the wont of human psychology that a person is never satisfied, because his goal is infinite and whatever he gets is finite. Suppose one has a weakness for cake. You are enjoying the cake, but only until it passes the tongue do you enjoy the taste. After that-the cake is finite, it is something finite, so when it comes here [points to the throat] the taste is lost. Similarly, it is human nature that a person wants to enjoy something infinite. But in our world of relativities nothing is infinite, everything is finite.
summary: It is the wont of human psychology that a person is never satisfied, because his goal is infinite and whatever he gets is finite.
After that-the cake is finite, it is something finite, so when it comes here [points to the throat] the taste is lost.
But in our world of relativities nothing is infinite, everything is finite.

paragraphs.text: So all [[sorts]] of enjoyment are finite. The only infinite entity is Parama Puruśa. So when one loves Parama Puruśa, one enjoys infinite pleasure, infinite bliss.
summary: So all [[sorts]] of enjoyment are finite.
The only infinite entity is Parama Puruśa.
So when one loves Parama Puruśa, one enjoys infinite pleasure, infinite bliss.

paragraphs.text: So “Ráma” means “Parama Puruśa”, because Yogins, that is, spiritual aspirants, get infinite pleasure in Him – the only object from which they get pleasure. All other things are finite, just like the cake.
summary: So “Ráma” means “Parama Puruśa”, because Yogins, that is, spiritual aspirants, get infinite pleasure in Him – the only object from which they get pleasure.
All other things are finite, just like the cake.
All other things are finite, just like the cake.

paragraphs.text: Another meaning of “Ráma” is “Ráti mahiidhara Ráma” – “the most glittering object in the entire universe.” It is the most glittering Entity because all other entities get light from it. Here in our solar system the sun is the most glittering entity because [[all]] planets are getting light from the sun. There are so many solar systems in the universe, and all those solar systems get light from Parama Puruśa. Hence, He is Ráma. He is the source of all lights, all energies.
summary: Another meaning of “Ráma” is “Ráti mahiidhara Ráma” – “the most glittering object in the entire universe.
Here in our solar system the sun is the most glittering entity because [[all]] planets are getting light from the sun.
He is the source of all lights, all energies.

paragraphs.text: The sun may die. Other stars may die. When will they die? When they don't get sufficient energy from the Cosmic Nucleus. But as long as they are getting that energy they are living. Similarly, when a human structure gets heat and other energies from Him, that structure is a living structure. When Parama Puruśa wants this boy or this girl to change the body, to get another body, He stops supplying energy to that particular body, and starts supplying fresh energy to a new body. We say it the person's rebirth. So the most glittering entity, the stock or the original source of all energies, is Parama Puruśa. Hence, He is “Rama.”
summary: When they don't get sufficient energy from the Cosmic Nucleus.
When Parama Puruśa wants this boy or this girl to change the body, to get another body, He stops supplying energy to that particular body, and starts supplying fresh energy to a new body.
So the most glittering entity, the stock or the original source of all energies, is Parama Puruśa.

paragraphs.text: And a third meaning is “Rávańasya marańam Rámah.”
summary: And a third meaning is “Rávańasya marańam Rámah.

paragraphs.text: In this Universe two forces are functioning simultaneously. One is Vidyá, the other is Avidyá. “Vidyá” means “centripetal force” and “Avidyá” is “centrifugal force.” Vidyá is the centre-seeking force; that is, Vidyá is helping everybody in their movement towards the Supreme Nucleus; it is the centre-seeking force. And the other force is Avidyá.
summary: In this Universe two forces are functioning simultaneously.
“Vidyá” means “centripetal force” and “Avidyá” is “centrifugal force.
And the other force is Avidyá.

paragraphs.text: Now, the human mind undergoes distortions due to the influence of Avidyá. And due to the influence of Avidyá, human propensities, moving in so many directions – in ten directions - the human structure gets distorted. Now this human mind is moving in ten directions under the influence of Avidyá. Avidyá is just like a demon. It has deteriorating effect on the human mind. Hence it is known as a “demon.” The human mind, being influenced by that centrifugal force, moves towards crude matter, and when the goal is matter, the very structure is also turned into matter. Because the mind takes the form of [[its]] object, so where matter is the object, the mind is slowly converted to matter. So this Avidyá, goading the human mind unto crude objects in ten directions, is called “Rávańa”.
summary: Now, the human mind undergoes distortions due to the influence of Avidyá.
It has deteriorating effect on the human mind.
So this Avidyá, goading the human mind unto crude objects in ten directions, is called “Rávańa”.

paragraphs.text: There are ten directions. East, west, north, south, up, down – these six directions are called “Pradisha”; and the four corners are called “Anudisha.” These are the ten directions. It is called a ten – it is just like a ten-faced demon. The ten-faced demon is called “Rávana.”
summary: There are ten directions.
” These are the ten directions.
The ten-faced demon is called “Rávana.

paragraphs.text: Now how can you kill, how can you destroy this Rávańa? This depraving force, this degenerating force is “Rávańa.” How can you destroy the Rávańa? You can destroy this Rávańa only when you take shelter in Parama Puruśa. So “Rávańasya marańam Rámah” here “Ráma” means “Parama Puruśa”. Without the help of Parama Puruśa one cannot destroy this ten-faced demon.
summary: Now how can you kill, how can you destroy this Rávańa?
You can destroy this Rávańa only when you take shelter in Parama Puruśa.
Without the help of Parama Puruśa one cannot destroy this ten-faced demon.

paragraphs.text: This demon is inimical not only to a particular person but to a family, to the entire human society. And this demon is the worst, rather, the blackest spot in the human mind – in our individual life, also in our collective life. And this darkest spot in the human mind is mutual intolerance and hatred. A spiritual aspirant must know that in a civilized society there is no scope, no room, and no option for hatred or mutual intolerance. All are equally-blessed human beings. All have the same parentage, and will have to move with all others. And our process of marching should go on until all of humanity attains salvation.
summary: This demon is inimical not only to a particular person but to a family, to the entire human society.
A spiritual aspirant must know that in a civilized society there is no scope, no room, and no option for hatred or mutual intolerance.
And our process of marching should go on until all of humanity attains salvation.

chapters.title: A Purely Personal Entity

paragraphs.text: You know Lalita Mármika dance used during Kiirtana is a purely spiritual dance, and Kaośikii is a psycho-spiritual dance – it starts on the psychic level and culminates on the spiritual level. And Táńd́ava is physico-psycho-spiritual.
summary: You know Lalita Mármika dance used during Kiirtana is a purely spiritual dance, and Kaośikii is a psycho-spiritual dance – it starts on the psychic level and culminates on the spiritual level.
And Táńd́ava is physico-psycho-spiritual.
And Táńd́ava is physico-psycho-spiritual.

paragraphs.text: In Lalita Mármika, the position of the arms is above 90 degrees. This denotes that it is a Mudrá – in Saḿskrta it is called a “Mudrá”. This Mudrá means, “O Supreme Creator, Thou art mine and I am Yours. I am Thine.”
summary: In Lalita Mármika, the position of the arms is above 90 degrees.
This denotes that it is a Mudrá – in Saḿskrta it is called a “Mudrá”.
This Mudrá means, “O Supreme Creator, Thou art mine and I am Yours.

paragraphs.text: Now everywhere in the world you will see one entity is in the possessive case and another is owned by that person or that entity. That is, each and every object has a certain entitative relationship with others. And what's the entitative relationship with the Supreme Creator? The Supreme Creator belongs to one and all and the created beings all belong to the Supreme Entity.
summary: Now everywhere in the world you will see one entity is in the possessive case and another is owned by that person or that entity.
And what's the entitative relationship with the Supreme Creator?
The Supreme Creator belongs to one and all and the created beings all belong to the Supreme Entity.

paragraphs.text: This is the philosophical interpretation. Even in the field of occult science it is the interpretation. But for a devotee, the interpretation is not like that.
summary: This is the philosophical interpretation.
Even in the field of occult science it is the interpretation.
But for a devotee, the interpretation is not like that.

paragraphs.text: Amongst devotees three clear categories, One category, call it “third-grade,” says, “O Lord, You belong to everybody – You belong to one and all – and because I am also included within the scope of 'all', You belong to me also.” And the second-grade devotee will say, “No, no, no. That is not the correct psychic approach. You belong to me, and because You belong to me You belong to all. That is, the first thing is that You belong to me. And the second thing, because You belong to me, is that You belong to others also.” And the first-grade devotee says, “No, no, no, that's not the correct approach. You belong t me and You belong to me only and not to others. The relationship is purely personal. I don't know any philosophy, I don't know any occult science. I know that You are mine and I am Yours. In this realm of relationship I do not allow any third person to come. The relationship is purely mutual. I will share anything and everything with others; but You are one hundred percent mine.”
summary: Amongst devotees three clear categories, One category, call it “third-grade,” says, “O Lord, You belong to everybody – You belong to one and all – and because I am also included within the scope of 'all', You belong to me also.
You belong t me and You belong to me only and not to others.
I will share anything and everything with others; but You are one hundred percent mine.

paragraphs.text: I hope you boys and you girls belong to the first grade of devotees. That is, the relationship is a personal one.
summary: I hope you boys and you girls belong to the first grade of devotees.
That is, the relationship is a personal one.
That is, the relationship is a personal one.

paragraphs.text: And regarding this personal relationship there are some other important aspects of philosophy. Now, in pure philosophy, Parama Puruśa is an impersonal Entity. In occult science He is a blending of personal and impersonal Entities. Just now I said that in philosophy Parama Puruśa is an impersonal Entity. He is the Nucleus of this Cosmic order. That Nucleus is certainly not a personal Entity. Because He is above the scope of all mundane explanations. So He is certainly an impersonal Entity. And in the realm of spiritual cult, He is a blending of personal and impersonal Entities. That is, while approaching Him, while accepting Him as the only object of adoration, He is looked upon as a personal Entity. But when His entitative existence is accepted not as the object of adoration but as the source of creation, in that case He is an impersonal Entity. That's why I said that in the cult of spirituality He is a blending of personal and impersonal Entities.
summary: And regarding this personal relationship there are some other important aspects of philosophy.
Because He is above the scope of all mundane explanations.
That's why I said that in the cult of spirituality He is a blending of personal and impersonal Entities.

paragraphs.text: But in the realm of devotion He is purely a personal Entity. He is mine, He is my Father, He is my closest relative. He is my bigger self. He is not a second entity; that is, the relationship is purely a personal one. There cannot be any love with an impersonal entity. One cannot be in love with an impersonal entity. Love requires a personal entity.
summary: But in the realm of devotion He is purely a personal Entity.
He is not a second entity; that is, the relationship is purely a personal one.
Love requires a personal entity.

paragraphs.text: Now as the relationship is a personal one, and as the entity of Parama Puruśa is purely a personal one in the field of divinity or in the field of devotion, the interpretation of the creation also varies from that of philosophy or that of occult spirituality. Ask a philosopher why this Universe was created, for what Parama Puruśa created this Universe. He won't be able to satisfy you with His reply. He'll say “Perhaps this was His idea or perhaps that was His idea, perhaps this was the motive, perhaps that was the motive;” but the reply is vague. Not to the point, never to the point. Ask an adherent of the actional cult. He won't be able to satisfy you with his reply. He'll say, “There are so many flows of expression. This Universe is a [[mesh]] of waves of different lengths, of different sounds, of different colours.”
summary: Now as the relationship is a personal one, and as the entity of Parama Puruśa is purely a personal one in the field of divinity or in the field of devotion, the interpretation of the creation also varies from that of philosophy or that of occult spirituality.
Not to the point, never to the point.
This Universe is a [[mesh]] of waves of different lengths, of different sounds, of different colours.

paragraphs.text: But these replies won't satisfy a spiritual aspirant. The spiritual aspirant, or the devotee, will say the reply is very simple – “Before the creation, my Supreme Father was alone in this Universe. There was nothing, and for want of the quinquelemental factors, there was nothing to see, nothing to do. He was alone. Suppose you are alone in a particular village or in a particular house. What will be your position? What will be your mental condition? You will be just like – what? An insane person, a madman. So in this vast Cosmos my Father was alone. Just try to feel what His condition was, what His mental condition was. So just to save Himself from the monotony of singularity, He created this Universe. Just to play with His children. This is the only reason. I know no other philosophy.” This will be the reply of the devotee.
summary: But these replies won't satisfy a spiritual aspirant.
An insane person, a madman.
” This will be the reply of the devotee.

paragraphs.text: Sá vá eśa tadá drśt́á na pashya drshya mekarát́ Me me santamuvátmánam supta shaktirasupta dik.
summary: Sá vá eśa tadá drśt́á na pashya drshya mekarát́ Me me santamuvátmánam supta shaktirasupta dik.

paragraphs.text: And this creation, what is it? It is nothing but different portions of His Divine body. And that's why I said that there is no sinner in this world. All are his loving children. You boys, you girls – forget your past and start your life afresh with this subtlest and noblest idea – that you are inseparable particles of that Supreme Entity, of that Parama Puruśa.
summary: And this creation, what is it?
And that's why I said that there is no sinner in this world.
You boys, you girls – forget your past and start your life afresh with this subtlest and noblest idea – that you are inseparable particles of that Supreme Entity, of that Parama Puruśa.
